booking.instructions: Call (770) 977-5547 to reserve an appointment, or leave your details here and we'll follow up by email.

demo_chips: Can I get a crown in one day?
fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach Waldron & Lee Dentistry at (770) 977-5547, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.a: Often, yes - we have CEREC technology onsite, so certain crowns can be designed and placed the very same day, with no temporary crown and no second visit. Call (770) 977-5547 and the team will tell you if your tooth is a candidate.
faqs.q: Can I really get a crown in one day?

faqs.a: Yes - emergencies are part of everyday care here. If you're in pain or a tooth breaks, call (770) 977-5547 and the team will help you as quickly as they can.

New patients and most insurance plans are welcome. If you don't have insurance, ask about our Friends and Family Plan - it was made for exactly that. Call (770) 977-5547 and the team can check your coverage.

That is exactly who this office was built for. You'll get sedation options, private treatment suites with massaging chairs and ceiling-mounted TVs, a comfort menu, and an honest team that promises never to sell you services you don't need - it feels more like visiting a friend's house than a dental office.
faqs.q: I'm anxious about dental visits - what do you do differently?

faqs.a: We're in Marietta, Georgia, at 2419 Roswell Rd - serving families across Marietta and the East Cobb area.
We've been serving Marietta and East Cobb patients for over 40 years, with a culture of friendly, empathetic, clinically excellent care - and more than 2,500 five-star reviews from your neighbors.
